paragraphs.text: In a large family with atrial standstill, Groenewegen et al. (2003) used candidate gene screening to identify a novel mutation in the SCN5A gene, asp1275-to-asn (D1275N). They found it in all 3 affected living relatives and in 5 unaffected relatives, and the deceased affected relative was an obligate carrier. Eight relatives were homozygous for 2 closely linked rare polymorphisms in regulatory regions of the atrial-specific connexin-40 gene (GJA5), -44G-A and +71A-G. Three of these 8 were affected, and the 3 living patients were the only relatives who had coinherited both the rare Cx40 genotype and the SCN5A D1275N mutation. Compared with wildtype channels, SCN5A D1275N channels showed a small depolarizing shift in activation. The rare Cx40 genotype reduced reporter gene expression compared with the more common Cx40 genotype. The authors proposed that although each genetic change has a relatively benign functional effect, their combined effect eventually progresses to total atrial standstill.

paragraphs.text: In an 11-year-old boy with congenital atrial standstill, Makita et al. (2005) identified a novel SCN5A mutation, leu212-to-pro (L212P). The mutation was also present in his father, who was in normal sinus rhythm. In whole-cell patch-clamp studies, the recombinant L212P channel showed a large hyperpolarizing shift in the voltage dependence of activation (wildtype -48.1 mV vs L212P -63.5 mV) and of inactivation (wildtype -86.6 mV vs L212P -95.6 mV), as well as delayed recovery from inactivation. Further screening for genetic variations that might mitigate L212P dysfunction showed that the proband, but not his father, carried connexin-40 polymorphisms inherited from his asymptomatic mother.

checks.evidence_quote: The father was in normal sinus rhythm.

checks.claim: The proband with the SCN5A L212P mutation reported by Makita et al. (2005), but not his father, carried connexin-40 polymorphisms.
checks.evidence_quote: the proband, but not his father, carries Cx40 polymorphisms

checks.claim: The proband with the SCN5A L212P mutation reported by Makita et al. (2005) inherited the connexin-40 polymorphisms from his asymptomatic mother.
checks.evidence_quote: carries Cx40 polymorphisms inherited from his asymptomatic mother.

checks.claim: In patch-clamp studies by Makita et al. (2005), the SCN5A L212P channel showed a large hyperpolarizing shift in the voltage dependence of activation (wildtype -48.1 mV vs L212P -63.5 mV).
